sgvpaarogyam.com · live screenshots · 30 Sep 2026

What our website shows visitors today, and how we fix it

Twelve screenshots taken from the live site and two competitors. Each slide gives the issue and the fix. Full evidence and the growth plan are in the website audit.

Red label: a problem on our siteGreen label: something to copy or use

Presenting: press → / ↓ or Space for the next slide, ← / ↑ for the previous one. Press F11 for full screen.

01 / 12 · Homepage

Homepage banner: spelling mistake

Issue"Non-Hormornal … PMOS" is part of the banner image, so it cannot be edited as text and Google cannot read it. The banner has 14 slides; most visitors see one or two.
How to fixCorrect the artwork, put the headline in the slide's text field, and cut the banner to 4 slides with the best product first.
02 / 12 · Homepage

Homepage banner: cure-style claims

IssueSlide 2 prints "breaks the stone" and "prevents recurrence". The same kind of wording is in 17 page titles. Google and Meta reject ads for pages like this, and it carries legal risk.
How to fixA lawyer-approved phrase list ("supports urinary health", "traditionally used for …") applied to banners, titles and product text.
03 / 12 · Trust

Product page on a phone: no proof

IssueNo star rating, no reviews and no GMP or AYUSH licence near the price. The description opens by naming a disease, misspelt "Diabetese". Only two photos.
How to fixCollect 10 reviews per best-selling product on WhatsApp; add a trust strip (GMP · AYUSH no. · Made at SGVP · COD · 7-day return) and a back-label photo.
04 / 12 · Trust

Footer: our credentials are hidden

IssueThree tiny certificate logos with no licence numbers and no link. No WhatsApp. Still says "Copyright 2025".
How to fixA "Quality & Licences" page with full certificates, licence numbers in text and plant photos, linked from every product page.
05 / 12 · B2B

Stock List: distributor numbers are public

IssueAbout 30 distributors listed with addresses and mobile numbers (blurred in this screenshot, fully visible on the live site). A competitor can copy the network in a minute, and there is no way to apply to become a stockist.
How to fixRemove the numbers today. Replace with "Become a stockist": territories, margins, requirements and a short form with WhatsApp. Keep a consumer "Where to buy" with shop name and area only.
06 / 12 · B2B

Contact page: one form for everyone

IssueDistributor, doctor and customer enquiries all land in the same form. No WhatsApp, no map, no reply-time promise, and no "For Business" link in the menu.
How to fixAdd "For Business" to the menu with four pages: Distributors · Doctors & clinics · PCD franchise · Bulk & gifting. Each gets its own form asking for drug licence and GST number.
07 / 12 · Opportunity

Free consultation: we have it, but hide it

What it showsThis page already exists, with WhatsApp, but no menu or product page links to it.
What to doPut "Free Vaidya Consultation" in the main menu, on every product page and as a floating WhatsApp button. About two hours of work.
08 / 12 · Google

Unfinished product, live on Google

IssueHiponorm has no photo, no price and no description, and shows "Coming soon", yet it is published and indexed.
How to fixSet it to Draft until it is finished.
09 / 12 · Google

Internal tax grouping made public

IssueThe URL says "12-gst" and the page says "18% GST". It is an internal tax grouping, published and indexed by Google.
How to fixCollections → this collection → Sales channels → untick Online Store. Do the same for "tablets-5-gst".
10 / 12 · Google

CEO page is dead but still sent to Google

Issue"From the desk of CEO" returns a 404 error and is still listed in the sitemap.
How to fixRestore the page (it builds trust with institutional buyers) or redirect it to About Us.
11 / 12 · Competitors

What good looks like: Jiva Ayurveda

What it showsThe whole homepage is built to start a consultation: "Book Free Consultation", a call-back form ("call in 5–10 mins"), the phone number in the header and a WhatsApp button.
What to doCopy the pattern: a consultation offer and WhatsApp as the main call to action on our homepage and product pages.
12 / 12 · Competitors

What good looks like: Dr Vaidya's

What it showsWhatsApp in the header on every page, a B2B "Contract Manufacturing" page in the main menu, and delivery offers in the top bar.
What to doAdd WhatsApp to our header, "For Business" to our menu, and a free-shipping / COD offer bar.
